title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says neocloud demand is 'off the charts' but capital is scarce
summary_full: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC Thursday that demand for neocloud firms is "off the charts," but scarce capital is holding back growth.
summary_public: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC Thursday that demand for neocloud firms is "off the charts," but scarce capital is holding back growth.
